# OrderMate

OrderMate is operations software for growing small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs).

It connects inventory, customer orders, purchasing, suppliers, warehouse execution, cycle counts, wave picking, reporting and human-reviewed automation in one auditable workspace.

## Core capabilities

- Multi-location inventory with on-hand, reserved, available and incoming stock.
- Immutable stock movement history for adjustments, transfers, receipts, fulfilment, returns and stocktakes.
- Customer orders with stock reservation, oversell prevention, fulfilment priority, required-by dates, partial fulfilment and returns.
- Purchase orders with suppliers, expected delivery dates, partial receiving, cancellation and discrepancy handling.
- Warehouse workflows for manual barcode entry, hardware scanners and mobile-camera scanning.
- Wave Picking for 2–10 same-location orders with deterministic allocation back to exact order lines.
- Cycle counts with stale-snapshot and reservation protection.
- Deterministic replenishment suggestions using stock, incoming supply, demand and lead time.
- Operations reports over canonical stock, order and purchasing records.
- Reviewed document extraction and matching workflows. AI may propose information for human review but does not autonomously mutate canonical stock, fulfil orders or commit purchase orders.
- Role-based access for owners, administrators, managers, inventory, fulfilment and viewer users.
- Tenant-isolated operational storage and audited mutation paths.

## Audience

OrderMate is aimed at SMEs that have outgrown disconnected spreadsheets and manual operational reconciliation but do not want an unnecessarily heavy enterprise system.

## Product principle

Automate repetitive operational work while keeping important business decisions explicit, reviewable and attributable to people.
